 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Overlay the two non-background patterns across a solid separator; mark overlap with 2."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # A full, uniform nonzero line separates the two pattern panels.
    for c in range(w):
        vals = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h)]
        if vals[0] != 0 and all(v == vals[0] for v in vals):
            left = [row[:c] for row in grid]
            right = [row[c + 1:] for row in grid]
            n = min(c, w - c - 1)
            return [[2 if left[r][j] != 0 and right[r][j] != 0 else 0
                     for j in range(n)] for r in range(h)]
    for r in range(h):
        vals = grid[r]
        if vals[0] != 0 and all(v == vals[0] for v in vals):
            top = grid[:r]
            bottom = grid[r + 1:]
            n = min(r, h - r - 1)
            return [[2 if top[i][c] != 0 and bottom[i][c] != 0 else 0
                     for c in range(w)] for i in range(n)]
    raise ValueError("No solid separator found")
